title: Walkable Nashville Stay. Steps to Bars & Eats
description:
Grab coffee, head to brunch, explore nightlife and enjoy live music - all without needing a car.

This brand new, modern townhouse with free parking is the perfect home for entertaining. Groups keen on traveling together will appreciate both the bright, open floor plan on the main level, as well as the personal space provided in each suite.

The space
The entire top floor consists of two spacious suites. One suite features a king bed, walk-in shower, double vanity, television, and walk-in closet. The second suite includes a shower/tub combination and a bunk bed with a queen, full XL, and twin trundle bed. The ground floor offers a private queen bedroom with an en-suite bathroom.

Walkable to Grimey's Record Store with the new Taylor Swift mural, Living Waters Brewery & Coffee, Tiger Bar, The Fox Bar and Cocktail Club, The Bowery Vault, Elegy Coffee, Nicoletto's Pasta & Mickey's Tavern.

The fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar opens to a large dining set happily accommodating 8 seated guests. 

Living room has queen sleeper sofa and plenty of seating for hangout space.

Free parking for two cars in the attached carport.

Other things to note
This is a three story home with one suite on the ground floor, living space on the middle floor and the other two suites on the top floor.
